feeBreakdown.label: Resource fees do not apply to Competency-Based / Direct Assessment

missing: Applicable taxes, repeated-course charges and personal living costs are not included.
notes: The exact university graduate program requires every listed course at Phoenix; no incoming undergraduate or other-program transfer award is priced.
The published admission degree, GPA, work-experience and state-availability conditions apply before enrollment.
University scheduling, assessment mastery and the capstone completed-credit prerequisite control the actual course sequence.
At $300 per credit, the complete 33-credit baseline tuition is $9,900. The program page states no additional fees.
Nine to twelve credits represent three to four three-credit courses in a sixteen-week period; a final partial course group and capstone eligibility follow the university schedule.

feeBreakdown.label: Resource fees do not apply to Competency-Based / Direct Assessment

missing: Applicable taxes, repeated-course charges and personal living costs are not included.
notes: The exact university graduate program requires every listed course at Phoenix; no incoming undergraduate or other-program transfer award is priced.
The published admission degree, GPA, work-experience and state-availability conditions apply before enrollment.
University scheduling, assessment mastery and the capstone completed-credit prerequisite control the actual course sequence.

Only two, three or four three-CU courses are scheduled per term; the maximum is twelve CUs per term and thirty-nine graduate CUs in twelve months. This range is three to six paid terms for the full thirty-six-CU plan.
This Direct Assessment psychology program does not qualify for Title IV federal financial aid or psychologist licensure.
